question: What is the name of the physical feature that is the longitudinal valley lying between the Lesser Himalayas and the Siwalik in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Duns**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Duns** are the longitudinal valleys that lie between the Lesser Himalayas and the Siwalik ranges in India.
 
• These valleys are formed due to the folding of the Siwalik ranges and are characterized by flat-bottomed, elongated depressions.
 
• Prominent examples of such valleys include the Dehradun, Kotli Dun, and Patli Dun.
